reason: Hypothesis A proposes a physically sound mechanism (enhanced spin-orbit coupling from Ir) to increase coercivity in a FeCoNi-based high-entropy alloy, directly addresses the limitation of soft ferromagnetism in prior Pd/Pt derivatives, and provides a clear, testable experiment. Hypothesis B relies on Cr to induce antiferromagnetic interactions and possible phase changes, but Cr is known to reduce saturation magnetization and may not maintain the required single-phase fcc structure, making its mechanism less reliable and its contribution less substantive.
